speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum.

The description of a painful ulcer with a central necrotic base, purplish irregular borders, and the development following an ant bite (pathergy), combined with your history of Crohn's disease, is highly characteristic of this condition. I am not requesting further tests at this time, as the clinical picture is distinct from an infection like cellulitis.
